name: Question 17
problem:
Find the gradient of the product $f(x,y)g(x,y),$ given that 

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x,y) & =xy,\, &  & ∇f(x,y)=y\text{ }i+x\text{ }j, &  &  \\ g(x,y) & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(xy),\, &  & ∇g(x,y)=\frac{1}{x}\text{ }i+\frac{1}{y}\text{ }j. &  & \end{aligned}
$$

Question 17
?

Find the gradient of the product f(x,y)g(x,y), given that f(x,y)=xy,∇f(x,y)=y i+x j,g(x,y)=ln⁡(xy),∇g(x,y)=1x i+1y j.

a
yln⁡(xy) i+xln⁡(xy) j
b
y(ln⁡(xy)+2) i+x(ln⁡(xy)+2) j
c
y(ln⁡(xy)+1) i+x(ln⁡(xy)+1) j
d
xln⁡(xy) i−yln⁡(xy) j
e
xln⁡(xy) i+yln⁡(xy) j
Submit
